race.title: Noreside Catering Handicap Chase
race.verdict: Making her handicap chase debut, BREAK MY SOUL produced her best effort over fences when third in the Grand Annual at Cheltenham and, with a good record fresh, she is taken to add to her C&D victory a year ago. Golden Joy was a good second at Leopardstown in February and is feared most for his new yard. BREAK MY SOUL (IRE) GOLDEN JOY (FR) LEAVE IN SECRET (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: Break My Soul (8/11), Golden Joy (5/1), Indiana Jones (8/1), Leave In Secret (10/1), Drumgill (12/1), Maidenstreetprince (14/1), Mount Frisco (16/1)
